import json
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'C:\Users\stop-\n1-kanji-workspace\review-tools')
from common import WS, freeze_json, frozen, git, require, sha, start_guard, write_frozen
from confirm_v2 import clean
here = WS / 'scratch-126' / 'review'
raw = (WS / 'scratch-126' / 'handoff-001' / 'handoff.json').read_bytes()
require(sha(raw) == 'b36ebc8e28031723eb16686b65c7e34e86c0a266147feeb50ce264a15dd9a43e', 'Handoff changed')
handoff = json.loads(raw)
proof = json.loads(frozen(here / 'coordinator-candidate-verification.json', '0d3be59a7cf6f2f95e9d5b049c608e2e9b0152aca031012a57d2892420c5f8a6'))
config = json.loads(frozen(here / 'batch.json'))
require(handoff['candidate'] == config['candidate'] == proof['candidate'] and handoff['base'] == config['base'] == proof['base'], 'Handoff snapshot differs')
require(handoff['contributorChanges']['allChangedPaths'] == sorted(proof['changedPaths']) and len(proof['changedPaths']) == 79, 'Changed path inventory differs')
clean(config, config['candidate'])
guard, _ = start_guard('B126 complete runtime handoff verification')
try:
    manifest = json.loads(git(config, 'show', config['candidate'] + ':manifest.json'))
    hashes = {path: digest for group in manifest.values() if isinstance(group, dict) for path, digest in group.items()}
    actual = {}
    for name, digest in hashes.items():
        guard.check()
        data = (Path(config['repo']) / Path(name)).read_bytes()
        if name.endswith(('.md', '.json')):
            data = data.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
        actual[name] = sha(data)
        require(actual[name] == digest, 'Runtime hash mismatch: ' + name)
    require(len(actual) == 8714, 'Runtime count differs')
    preserves = {}
    for name, binding in handoff['preservation'].items():
        directory = WS / 'scratch-126' / name
        summary_raw = (directory / 'summary.json').read_bytes()
        runtime_raw = (directory / 'runtime-hashes.json').read_bytes()
        summary = json.loads(summary_raw)
        require(sha(summary_raw) == binding['summarySha256'] and sha(runtime_raw) == binding['runtimeHashesSha256'] and json.loads(runtime_raw) == actual, 'Preservation evidence differs')
        require(summary['status'] == 'PASS' and not summary['memory']['breach'] and summary['allCandidateRuntimeHashesChecked'] == len(actual), 'Preservation did not pass')
        if name == 'preservation-committed-001':
            require(summary['head'] == config['candidate'], 'Committed preservation snapshot differs')
        preserves[name] = {'summarySha256': sha(summary_raw), 'runtimeHashesSha256': sha(runtime_raw)}
    for name, binding in handoff['gates'].items():
        summary_raw = (WS / 'scratch-126' / name / 'summary.json').read_bytes()
        require(sha(summary_raw) == binding['summarySha256'], 'Gate handoff summary differs')
        summary = json.loads(summary_raw)
        require(summary['logs'] == binding['individualLogAndReceiptBindings'], 'Gate handoff individual hashes differ')
    for name, digest in handoff['sourceBindings']['comparisonEvidence'].items():
        require(sha(git(config, 'show', config['candidate'] + ':docs/n1-sources/batch-126/' + name)) == digest, 'Source handoff differs: ' + name)
    require(git(config, '-c', 'core.whitespace=cr-at-eol', 'diff', '--check', config['base'], config['candidate']) == b'', 'CRLF-aware whitespace errors')
    clean(config, config['candidate'])
finally:
    memory = guard.finish()
require(not memory['breach'], 'Runtime verification memory breach')
preparer = WS / 'review-tools' / 'prepare_b126_review_tools.py'
derivation = json.loads(frozen(here / 'guarded-test-derivation.json'))
require(sha(preparer.read_bytes()) == derivation['producerSha256'] == '673d25733d0dfe8796cfacea3d40c53f7c34ea6e0678ea85b14980bfc152119b', 'Primary preparer changed')
preparer.chmod(stat.S_IREAD)
require(not [p.name for p in (WS / 'review-tools').glob('*.py') if p.stat().st_mode & stat.S_IWRITE], 'Unfrozen shared reviewer tool remains')
capture = write_frozen(here / 'author-handoff-001.json', raw)
print(json.dumps(freeze_json(here / 'handoff-verification-001.json', {
    'status': 'PASS', 'batch': 126, 'candidate': config['candidate'], 'base': config['base'],
    'handoff': capture, 'runtimeHashesChecked': len(actual), 'changedPathsChecked': len(proof['changedPaths']),
    'preservation': preserves, 'memory': memory,
    'scope': 'Complete actual runtime hashes, signed candidate binding, exact handoff and gate/source identities; not linguistic or publication acceptance.',
})))

memory.peakScope: Verifier Python process, including its monitor thread; not subprocess peaks.
memory.additionalChecks: Before each file and each streamed chunk; signal interruption on a sampled breach.
